name: io.github.Dominic-DK/askew-mcp
title: Askew — iPhone, iPad and Mac via Shortcuts
description: Run Shortcuts on your iPhone, iPad or Mac from any MCP agent, even locked. End-to-end encrypted.

environmentVariables.name: ASKEW_CONNECTOR_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Connector key from the Askew iPhone app (Settings → New connector). Starts with akc_.

environmentVariables.name: ASKEW_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Where the connector's private key file lives. Defaults to ~/.askew/connector.key.
